title: Japanese Pine Nut Madeleine Cake
description: A unique Japanese-inspired dessert featuring the delicate flavors of pine nuts and the crunch of madeleine cake. This sweet treat is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Cut the madeleine cake into small cubes.
In a pan, toast the pine nuts over low heat until fragrant.
In a separate bowl, mix together the shattering sugar and French butter until well combined.
Add the toasted pine nuts and sweet soy sauce to the bowl and mix until a smooth paste forms.
Combine the cake cubes and the pine nut paste in a separate bowl.
Mix until the cake is evenly coated with the pine nut paste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
